memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "They will summon peoples to the mountain and there offer the sacrifices of the righteous; they will feast on the abundance of the seas, on the treasures hidden in the sand. About Gad he said: 'Blessed is he who enlarges Gad's domain!'... About Dan he said: 'Dan is a lion's cub, springing out of Bashan.'" — Deut 33:19-22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses' blessings continue over Zebulun and Issachar, Gad, and Dan, with rich images of provision — feasting on the abundance of the seas, treasures hidden in the sand, enlarged territory, and lion-like strength. Notice that phrase: "treasures hidden in the sand." God's blessings often include hidden riches, good things tucked away in unlikely places, waiting to be discovered by those who walk with Him.

There is encouragement in this picture. Sometimes God's provision is not obvious on the surface. Like treasures hidden in the sand, His good gifts may be concealed, requiring us to trust and wait before we see them. But they are there, prepared by a generous God for His people.

We can also notice how these blessings speak of security and strength for the different tribes — enlarged domains, lion-like courage. God equips His people for the particular challenges they face. He does not send us out empty-handed, but supplies what each of us needs for our calling.

The greatest hidden treasure of all is found in Christ, in whom "are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge" (Col 2:3). The deepest riches God offers are not in sand or sea, but in His Son. And these treasures are freely available to all who seek them. So do not despair when God's provision seems hidden. Trust the generous God who conceals treasures for His people to find, and seek above all the riches hidden in Christ, worth more than all the abundance of the seas.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Can I trust God's provision even when it seems hidden from view?
2. How does seeing Christ as the greatest treasure reshape what I seek?
3. Where might God be inviting me to discover a "hidden treasure" of His grace?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You prepare treasures for Your people, even hidden ones. Help me trust Your provision when I cannot yet see it, and to seek above all the riches hidden in Christ. Amen.
